svg.title: The agent tries to read .env. zn-gate blocks the read before it happens and answers with a message like this (shortened): zn: .env holds plain-text secrets. Ask the user to run `zn env shadow .env` in their terminal: it moves the values to the local vault and leaves __ZN_<NAME>__ markers you can read and use. The agent reads the message and carries on. On Windows the message names the .cmd form: `zn.cmd env shadow .env`.
svg.text: What the agent is told instead
zn: .env holds plain-text secrets. Ask the user to run `zn env shadow .env` in their terminal: it
moves the values to the local vault and leaves __ZN_<NAME>__ markers you can read and use.
On Windows the message names the .cmd form: zn.cmd env shadow .env
